name: Weekly leaderboard
description: Every Monday at 9:00 company time, last full week's leaderboard (Monday to Sunday) in the ops channel, else the reports channel (D94): closers ranked by cash collected with their closes and close rate beside, setters ranked by sets (calls a setter booked) with the show rate of their sets beside. The same numbers the bot and the wrap-ups say (cash_collected and close_rate by closer, booked_set and show_rate by setter); only people with something in the week are listed. The period is the leaderboard step's (plain words: last week, this month); the day, time, channel and the line under the board are this workflow's. /leaderboard answers the same in Slack on demand.

nodes.title: Rank last week's closers by cash and setters by sets
